name: ai-native-sdlc
description: Seven reusable software delivery skills aligned with the AI-native SDLC loop: committed artifacts per stage, human gates, project-aware checks and evidence records.

interface.shortDescription: Seven skills for planning, building and delivering software.
interface.longDescription: Global software workflow toolkit built on the AI-native SDLC loop (Plan → Design → Build → Test → Deploy → Maintain): an explicitly invoked coordinator plus six focused skills for intent, design, implementation, verification, release and maintenance. Every stage commits an artifact the next stage reads, humans hold the gates, and the agent stops at the production gate. Uses the existing project toolchain and preserves scoped authorization.
